Profile Iodamide is an ionic monomeric iodinated radiographic contrast medium (see p.1474). It is used in many procedures and may be given intravenously or by other routes, for example by instilla- tion into the bladder or uterus; it has also been used for computed tomography. It is usually given as a 24 to 65% solution of the meglumine salt, or as a mixture of the sodium and meglumine salts; solutions of the sodium salt have also been used. The dose varies according to the procedure and route.
